name: Fukagawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Fukagawa city emblem in navy: a ring open at the top with pointed ends, enclosing a stylised leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Fukagawa, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 16 July 1963.

features.role: Fukagawa city emblem — a ring open at the top with pointed ends, enclosing a stylised leaf
